I am writing to refer Elena Morales (DOB: 1982-03-22), who has successfully completed her cardiac evaluation this month. The evaluation found that she has a condition of atrial fibrillation. Further insights into her treatment and management options will greatly aid in her care.

Best regards,
Dr. Ana Rivera
